timelineProviderSettings.description: Optional settings for timeline providers by type

containerSelector.description: CSS selector for the main container element

cssFiles.description: Array of CSS file paths to load

layoutTemplate.description: HTML template for the layout (inline HTML or template reference)

description:
Root configuration for the Eligius timeline engine.

This is the main configuration object passed to `EngineFactory.createEngine()`. It defines all aspects of the engine: timelines, actions, language settings, and more.
example:
```typescript const config: IEngineConfiguration = { id: '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000', engine: { systemName: 'EligiusEngine' }, containerSelector: '#eligius-container', cssFiles: ['styles/main.css'], language: 'en-US', layoutTemplate: '
', availableLanguages: [{ id: 'en', languageCode: 'en-US', label: 'English' }], initActions: [], actions: [], timelines: [] }; ```

systemName.description: Name of the engine system to use

TTimelineProviderSettings.description: Provider settings indexed by timeline type. Allows different configurations for 'animation' vs 'mediaplayer' timelines. A single timeline can override them with its own `positionSource` and `containerProvider` (see  {@link  ITimelineConfiguration.positionSource } ).

ITimelineProviderSettings.description:
Settings for a timeline provider.

Timeline providers are assembled from decomposed components:
- Position source: drives timeline position (required)
- Container provider: manages render container (optional)
- Playlist: manages multi-item navigation (optional)

All components are resolved dynamically via the resource importer using the `systemName` property, allowing custom implementations.

systemName.description:
Name of the position source class to instantiate. Resolved via the resource importer.

Built-in options: 'RafPositionSource', 'ScrollPositionSource', 'VideoPositionSource'

selector.description: CSS selector for sources that need a DOM element (scroll, video).

tickInterval.description:
Interval between position updates in milliseconds (RAF sources).

The default of 100 ms matches the 0.1 second precision at which actions are keyed. A larger interval emits fewer position updates (less work per second), but actions then start and end up to one interval late. Earlier releases defaulted to 1000.

sources.description: Media to load (video sources), each with its URL and MIME type, in order of preference. `VideoPositionSource` requires a non-empty list of browser-playable media files (video or audio, for example MP4, WebM or MP3).

additionalProperties.description: Additional configuration options passed to the position source constructor. Use this for custom position source implementations. `VideoPositionSource` rejects an `options` key (removed in 4.0.0).

IPositionSourceConfig.description:
Configuration for a position source.

Position sources drive timeline position. They are resolved dynamically via the resource importer using the `systemName` property.

Built-in position sources:
- `RafPositionSource`: RAF-based, drives timeline by elapsed time
- `ScrollPositionSource`: Scroll-based, drives timeline by scroll position
- `VideoPositionSource`: native HTML video element, drives timeline by media playback

options.description: Removed in 4.0.0. Put 'sources' and 'poster' directly in the position source settings.

systemName.description:
Name of the container provider class to instantiate. Resolved via the resource importer.

Built-in options: 'DomContainerProvider'

selector.description: CSS selector for the container element

additionalProperties.description: Additional configuration options passed to the container provider constructor. Use this for custom container provider implementations.

IContainerProviderConfig.description:
Configuration for a container provider.

Container providers manage DOM elements where timeline content is rendered. They are resolved dynamically via the resource importer using `systemName`.

Built-in container providers:
- `DomContainerProvider`: Manages a DOM element by selector

systemName.description:
Name of the playlist class to instantiate. Resolved via the resource importer.

Built-in options: 'SimplePlaylist'

identifierKey.description: Property key used to identify items. Used when selecting items by identifier (e.g., 'uri', 'id', 'chapterId').

additionalProperties.description: Additional configuration options passed to the playlist constructor. Use this for custom playlist implementations.

IPlaylistConfig.description:
Configuration for a playlist.

Playlists manage collections of items (e.g., video chapters) that can be selected and navigated. They are resolved dynamically via the resource importer using `systemName`.

Built-in playlists:
- `SimplePlaylist`: Basic playlist with array of items

ILabel.description: Represents a language option for the available languages list. Used for UI elements like language selection dropdowns.

startOperations.description: Operations to execute when the action starts

endOperations.description: Operations to execute when the action ends

IEndableActionConfiguration.description:
Configuration for an action that has both start and end operations.

Endable actions execute startOperations when triggered and endOperations when completed or reversed.

IOperationConfiguration<TOperationData>.description: An operation configuration. The systemName determines which operation type is used.

startOperations.description: Operations to execute when the action starts

eventName.description: Name of the event that triggers this action

eventTopic.description: Optional event topic for filtering (defaults to global topic)

IEventActionConfiguration.description:
Configuration for an event-triggered action.

Event actions execute in response to eventbus events.

uri.description: URI for timeline identification and switching

type.description: Timeline type: 'animation' or 'mediaplayer'. Selects the provider settings in `timelineProviderSettings`, which `positionSource` and `containerProvider` can override for this timeline.

loop.description: Whether the timeline should loop when complete

selector.description: CSS selector for the timeline's target element

timelineActions.description: Actions to execute at specific timeline positions

container.description: Optional container selector for the timeline. Defaults to the timeline selector if not specified. Used by position sources that don't have an intrinsic container.

positionSource.description:
Optional position source settings for this timeline only, merged over `timelineProviderSettings[type].positionSource`.

- Leave out `systemName` (or repeat the type's) to change single   settings, for example only the `selector` of a scroll timeline. The   other settings of the type still apply.
- Name a different `systemName` to give this timeline another kind of   source, for example a `ScrollPositionSource` chapter in a   configuration whose animation timelines use `RafPositionSource`. The   type's position source settings are then not used, and when every   timeline of a type does this, the type needs no   `timelineProviderSettings` entry.

A source that renders its own container (`VideoPositionSource`) is shared by every timeline of the type with the same effective settings, so only an override that changes the video settings creates a second video element. Other sources are created once per timeline, as without an override.

containerProvider.description: Optional container provider settings for this timeline only, merged over `timelineProviderSettings[type].container` by the same rules as `positionSource`. Timelines with the same effective settings share one container provider.

ITimelineConfiguration.description:
Configuration for a single timeline.

A timeline represents a time-based sequence of actions that can be played, paused, and seeked. Multiple timelines can exist in a configuration.
ITimelineConfiguration.example:
```typescript
const timeline: ITimelineConfiguration = {
  id: 'main-timeline',
  uri: 'timeline://main',
  type: 'animation',
  duration: 60,
  loop: false,
  selector: '#timeline-container',
  timelineActions: []
};
```

TimelineTypes.description: Describes the different kinds of timeline providers.

startOperations.description: Operations to execute when the action starts

endOperations.description: Operations to execute when the action ends

duration.description: Time range when this action is active (start/end in seconds)

ITimelineActionConfiguration.description:
Configuration for a timeline-bound action with duration.

Timeline actions execute at specific time ranges within a timeline.

IDuration.description: Describes a duration of time expressed in a start and an optional end range with a one second interval.

Name of the container provider class to instantiate. Resolved via the resource importer.

Built-in options: 'DomContainerProvider'

ITimelineFlow.description:
Configuration for timeline flow navigation.

Defines how timelines connect and transition between each other. Currently a placeholder type for future implementation.

ILocalesConfiguration.description: Top-level configuration object for all locales. Keys are language codes, values are inline data or external references.

TLocaleEntry.description: A single locale entry can be inline data or an external reference.

TLocaleData.description: Recursive interface for nested translation data. Compatible with rosetta's expected format. Uses interface to support recursive definition.

$ref.description: URL or relative path to JSON locale file

ILocaleReference.description: External locale file reference using JSON Reference syntax. The loader resolves these to TLocaleData at initialization.
